title: Advanced Relatives
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Mover las preposiciones antes de los pronombres relativos ('to whom', 'in which') es el sello distintivo del inglés académico y corporativo del más alto nivel. Has dominado una de las estructuras más elegantes del idioma.

parts.visual:
En el inglés hablado coloquial, solemos dejar las preposiciones al final de la oración. 
Coloquial: The client who I was talking TO. 
Coloquial: The meeting which we decided the budget IN. 

En inglés formal (C2), movemos la preposición ANTES del pronombre relativo. NUNCA usamos 'who' o 'that' después de una preposición; usamos 'WHOM' para personas y 'WHICH' para cosas. 

1. Personas (Preposición + whom): 
Formal: The client TO WHOM I was talking. 
Formal: The CEO, WITH WHOM I had lunch yesterday, is resigning.
parts.audio: Welcome to Advanced Relative Clauses. In conversational English, we often leave prepositions at the end of the sentence. For example: The client who I was talking TO. Or: The meeting which we decided the budget IN. But in highly formal C2 English, we move the preposition BEFORE the relative pronoun. Remember this golden rule: never use 'who' or 'that' directly after a preposition. We use 'WHOM' for people and 'WHICH' for things. Number 1: People. The colloquial sentence 'The client who I was talking TO' becomes the formal 'The client TO WHOM I was talking'. Another example: The CEO, WITH WHOM I had lunch yesterday, is resigning.

parts.visual:
2. Cosas (Preposición + which): 
Formal: The meeting DURING WHICH we decided the budget. 
Formal: The problem ABOUT WHICH we are arguing. 

3. Expresiones de cantidad (All of / Most of / None of): 
Se usan con 'whom' (personas) o 'which' (cosas). 
Ej: We have 50 employees, MOST OF WHOM work remotely. (La mayoría de los cuales). 
Ej: I read three reports, NONE OF WHICH were useful. (Ninguno de los cuales). 

4. Frases avanzadas: 
- The extent TO WHICH... (La medida en la cual/hasta qué punto...). 
Ej: We don't know the extent TO WHICH the market will crash.
parts.audio: Number 2: Things. We use a preposition plus 'which'. The colloquial 'The meeting which we decided the budget IN' becomes the formal 'The meeting DURING WHICH we decided the budget'. Another example: The problem ABOUT WHICH we are arguing. Number 3: Expressions of quantity. Phrases like 'all of', 'most of', or 'none of'. We pair these with 'whom' for people and 'which' for things. For example: We have 50 employees, MOST OF WHOM work remotely. Or: I read three reports, NONE OF WHICH were useful. Finally, Number 4: Advanced phrases. The phrase 'The extent TO WHICH' means 'how much' or 'to what degree'. For example: We don't know the extent TO WHICH the market will crash.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la cláusula relativa formal correcta.

questions.question: Colloquial: The manager who I spoke to. -> Formal: The manager ____ I spoke.
questions.explanation: Preposición + whom para personas: to whom.

questions.question: Colloquial: The project which we are working on. -> Formal: The project ____ we are working.
questions.explanation: Preposición + which para cosas: on which.

questions.question: The board interviewed five candidates, all of ____ were highly qualified.
questions.explanation: Para personas después de preposición (of): whom.

questions.question: I reviewed the three contracts, none of ____ contained the required clause.
questions.explanation: Para cosas después de preposición (of): which.

questions.question: The company ____ I work is going bankrupt. (En la cual).
questions.explanation: Trabajas 'for a company', entonces: for which.

questions.question: We are still trying to determine the extent ____ the system was hacked. (Hasta qué punto / En qué medida).
questions.explanation: The extent TO which = la medida/grado en la cual.

questions.question: The investors, many of ____ lost millions, are suing the CEO.
questions.explanation: Inversores son personas, se usa whom después de 'of'.

questions.question: Colloquial: The building that we met in. -> Formal: The building ____ we met.
The colleague ____ I share an office has resigned. (Con quien).
There are several reasons ____ we cannot accept this proposal. (Por las cuales).
questions.explanation: Reason FOR something -> reasons for which.

questions.question: The conditions ____ we operate are very strict. (Bajo las cuales).
He presented three solutions, the best of ____ was completely ignored.
questions.explanation: Solutions son cosas, se usa which después de 'of'.

questions.question: The man ____ I bought the car is my neighbor. (De quien).
They created a new law, according ____ all employees must wear badges. (De acuerdo con la cual).
questions.explanation: According TO something -> according to which.

questions.question: The speed ____ the market is changing is unprecedented. (A la cual).
Colloquial: The problem that we are looking at. -> Formal: The problem ____ we are looking.
questions.explanation: Look AT a problem -> at which.

questions.question: He introduced me to his team, some of ____ I already knew.
The process ____ the data is encrypted is very complex. (Mediante el cual).
questions.explanation: By a process -> by which (mediante el cual).

questions.question: The CEO, ____ leadership the company tripled its value, is retiring. (Bajo cuyo / Cuya).
questions.explanation: Whose = posesivo (cuya/cuyo). 'Under whose leadership' (bajo cuyo liderazgo).

questions.question: ¿Qué oración es gramaticalmente INCORRECTA en inglés C2?
options: The man to who I spoke.
The man to whom I spoke.
The city in which I live.
The meeting during which we decided.
questions.correct_answer: The man to who I spoke.
questions.explanation: Incorrecta: NUNCA se usa 'who' inmediatamente después de una preposición (to). Debe ser 'whom'.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el pronombre relativo correcto (whom, which).

questions.question: The person to ____ I gave the document.
The project on ____ we are working.
We have 10 cars, most of ____ are broken.
We have 10 engineers, most of ____ are busy.
The extent to ____ this is true is unknown.
The clients for ____ we built the software.
The rules by ____ we must play.
The woman with ____ I share the office.
The meeting during ____ we made the deal.
He gave three reasons, all of ____ were false.

pairs.target: La medida en la cual / Hasta qué punto
